pli-tv-bi-vb-pc18:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc18:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhaddāya kāpilāniyā antevāsinī bhikkhunī bhaddaṃ kāpilāniṃ sakkaccaṃ upaṭṭheti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc18:1.4: ayaṃ maṃ ayye bhikkhunī sakkaccaṃ upaṭṭheti imissāhaṃ cīvaraṃ dassāmīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc18:1.5: athakho sā bhikkhunī duggahitena dūpadhāritena paraṃ ujjhāpeti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc18:1.6: ahaṃ kirayye ayyaṃ na sakkaccaṃ upaṭṭhemi na kira me ayyā cīvaraṃ dassatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc18:1.7: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc18:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhunī duggahitena dūpadhāritena paraṃ ujjhāpessatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc18:1.9: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhunī duggahitena dūpadhāritena paraṃ ujjhāpetīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc18:1.12: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhunī duggahitena dūpadhāritena paraṃ ujjhāpessati
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc18:1.14: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc18:1.15.1: yā pana bhikkhunī duggahitena dūpadhāritena paraṃ ujjhāpeyya pācittiyanti.
